newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pirelli in A$40 million cable deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pirelli in A$40 million cable deal.

text.p: Pirelli Cables Australia Ltd said on Thursday it had been appointed preferred vendor for the bulk of Western Australia's requirements for medium and high voltage electricity cables in a deal worth A$40 to A$50 million.
Pirelli said the four year deal with Western Power, Western Australia's sole power utility, meant that more than 70 percent of the state's power cables would be made by Pirelli in Australia.
Pirelli said the remainder of Western Power's needs were to be sourced from a single overseas supplier.
The cables will be cut to length and delivered to site from a centralised warehouse operation in Perth, Pirelli said.
Pirelli Cables Australia is 51 percent owned by Pirell Cavi Spa.
Pirelli shares closed 1.5 cents lower at 46.5 cents on turnover of 40,000 shares.
